data.one_liner: Displays a customizable timetable widget for dates and times on items in a list.
data.what_it_does: Provides a timetable widget for Flutter that displays items over dates and times. Allows developers to customize each visible UI element through builder functions and manipulate the timetable state using a controller.
use_when: You need to display a calendar or schedule timetable in your Flutter app.
You want full customization over the UI elements of the timetable using builders.
avoid_when: You need built-in backend event syncing or heavily featured calendar management out of the box.
strengths: Includes a controller to manipulate the timetable and handle events.
weaknesses: Limited scope with few built-in components compared to massive calendar suites.
